discussion.key_messages: - Another storm system will bring significant mountain snow Thursday into Friday, with snow levels falling near to below 5000 feet by Friday. Another 6 to 12 inches of mountain snow, with locally higher amounts near 2 feet for the upper Cottonwoods is expected in northern Utah, while 4 to 10 inches of mountain snow is forecast for central and southern Utah. - Freezing temperatures are increasing in probability for the Virgin River corridor near Zion National Park Saturday and Sunday mornings.
